summary.text: Jerry Govan Jr. is a Democratic state representative from Orangeburg who represents South Carolina House District 93 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A retired Orangeburg County attendance supervisor and insurance agency owner, he serves on the Judiciary Committee and faces Republican Alex Morris in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jerry Govan Jr. was born on March 17, 1958, and earned a B.A. in 1982 and a master of arts in teaching in 2003 from South Carolina State University, according to the House member page.
He graduated from the Marine Corps Officer Candidate School in August 1980 and holds the rank of lieutenant colonel in the state military department, the page says.

The page lists earlier work including the Small Business Development Center at South Carolina State University, a pre-trial intervention program coordinator position and ownership of The Govan Agency, LLC, which sells insurance.

The House member page lists Govan's service in the House as 1993 to 2022 and describes him as a former second-ranking member of the House and a chairman of the South Carolina Legislative Black Caucus.
Ballotpedia reports that he won the District 93 general election on November 5, 2024, defeating Krista Hassell and Harold Geddings III.
His committee assignments are Judiciary, and Interstate Cooperation, where he is second vice chairman.
